title_suffix: classical-matrix capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673 + PR1699's Le Gall tau=12/5) on the pivot-566+554 T74 supplier
summary: Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier with the pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels (complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), using the matrix boundary specialised to Francois Le Gall's published omega<2.3728639 at tau=12/5 as proposed by Chafik Boukhalfa in PR1699 (the unproven omega_C<=9/4 premise is not used; the boundary row is nonbinding). PR1673's free strict slacks are set at 1e-64 or below (r0 1e-64, zeta 1e-66, layout slack 1e-64, stop 1e-70, floor grid 1e-100, backoff 1e-76) and b is the certified complex endpoint minus 1e-64 and q=b-1e-64, so the exact ledger kappa exceeds PR1699's exact kappa by a few 1e-25. Native profile {1:1560432,2:336336,3:278724,4:84912,5:54612,8:5328,48:22748}, c, m=73, W=66304 unchanged; the 48 strict inequalities, 6 rejecting controls and the endpoint rejection are regenerated with an independent balance derivation, the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses; the exponent is a cited theorem, not re-proved.
credits: Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699: classical-matrix specialisation of PR1673's boundary, tau=12/5) and Francois Le Gall (omega<2.3728639, Powers of Tensors and Fast Matrix Multiplication, ISSAC 2014). PR1673 (Vlado Vojdanovski, with AI assistance): capped phase-cell fusion outer construction, its proof and exact evidence, vendored verbatim under vendor/pr1673. Supplier: PR1625 (mdumitrean) pivot-566 helper-donor kernel; PR1661 (midhatn) 400-digit endpoint-grid refinement of that stack; pivot-554 kernel (kernel566.py search by LeverRank/jeremykothe2 tooling, PR1672); PR1297, PR1319, PR1424, PR1485, PR1574 (Rohan Arun) T74 exact fill and cold kernels; PR1274, PR1479, PR1510, PR1513, PR1536, PR1578 (Jeremy Kothe) endpoint and outer-witness lineage; PR1534, PR1549 (midhatn); PR1519 (philippeVV) fine-Mercator soundness repair; PR1286, PR1193 (Jeremy Diviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore) and the retained supplier lineage. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
